== Biography ==
William was born about 1806. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1189|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-1190|Elizabeth Glasgow]].  He passed away in 1880. <ref>Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/97876482/william-glasgow: accessed 05 November 2023), memorial page for William Glasgow (1806–16 Mar 1880), {{FindAGrave|97876482}}, citing Lowville Rural Cemetery, Lowville, Lewis County, New York, USA; Maintained by Ellen Blakeslee (contributor 34444055).</ref>
